properties.name: Camel Express
properties.note: Curb-to-curb Dial-A-Ride core zone covers the Town of Quartzsite plus the adjacent unincorporated La Paz Valley (an RV/desert area ~5 mi south of town) and Rainbow Acres, all within La Paz County; deviated flex routes extend further to Parker, Ehrenberg, Blythe, Yuma, and Lake Havasu City. No published zone boundary or size, so La Paz County is used as the containing unit at approximate fidelity rather than the town alone. Sources: https://www.ci.quartzsite.az.us/government/departments/transportation.php and https://cptdb.ca/wiki/index.php/Quartzsite_Camel_Express.
